## Perspective Audit Summary

**Component/artifact reviewed:** Address Autocomplete With Fast Timeout and Double-Action Enter
**Perspectives escalated for deep review:** Keyboard & Motor Access (HIGH), Screen Reader & Semantic Structure (MEDIUM), Cognitive & Neurodivergent (HIGH)
**Perspectives at LOW (not reviewed):** Magnification & Reflow, Environmental Contrast, Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity, Auditory Access

### Findings by Severity

| Severity | Count |
|---|---|
| CRITICAL | 2 |
| MAJOR | 3 |
| MINOR | 1 |
| ENHANCEMENT | 0 |

### Perspectives That Passed
None. All escalated perspectives surfaced at least one finding or red flag.

### Perspectives With Findings — Grouped by ARRM Role

**Front-End Dev**
- Suggestion list items unreachable by keyboard — Keyboard & Motor Access — CRITICAL — WCAG 2.1.1, 4.1.2
- Autocomplete input/listbox missing ARIA roles — Screen Reader & Semantic Structure — CRITICAL — WCAG 4.1.2
- Loading spinner lacks live region announcement — Screen Reader & Semantic Structure — MINOR — WCAG 4.1.3
- `autoComplete="off"` blocks browser autofill — Cognitive & Neurodivergent — MAJOR — WCAG 1.3.5

**UX Design**
- Suggestion dropdown auto-hides after 800ms regardless of user state — Cognitive & Neurodivergent — MAJOR — WCAG 2.2.1, 3.2.1

**Content Author**
- (Secondary routing for ARIA/labeling context; see Front-End Dev primary routes above)

### Open Questions Requiring Human Verification
- None. All findings are code-level and verifiable from the provided source.

### Recommended Next Step
**BLOCK** — CRITICAL findings present (keyboard trap/unreachable elements, missing ARIA roles for custom widget). Do not ship until resolved.

---

## Detailed Findings

### Perspective 5: Keyboard & Motor Access (HIGH)
**Checklist Results:**
- [FINDING] All interactive elements reachable/operable by keyboard alone (2.1.1)
- [PASS] No keyboard traps
- [PASS] Focus order logical
- [PASS] Focus indicator visible (≥3:1 contrast, ≥2px outline)
- [PASS] Activation fires on up-event
- [PASS] Visible label matches accessible name
- [PASS] Interactive targets ≥ 24x24 CSS px
- [N/A] Multi-point gestures, drag alternatives, orientation

**Finding:** Suggestion list items are non-interactive `<div>` elements with only `onClick` handlers. Keyboard users cannot navigate or select suggestions, breaking the autocomplete pattern.
**WCAG:** 2.1.1 (Keyboard), 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value)
**Perspective:** Keyboard & Motor Access
**Severity:** CRITICAL *(Red flag fired: Interactive element unreachable by keyboard)*
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (secondary: UX Design)
**Evidence:** JSX lines 78–86 (`<div className="suggestion-item" onClick={() => handleSelect(addr)}>`)
**Fix:** Add `role="option"`, `tabindex="-1"`, and keyboard event handlers (`onKeyDown` or global listener) to enable Arrow/Enter/Space navigation. Follow WAI-ARIA APG Combobox pattern.

### Perspective 6: Screen Reader & Semantic Structure (MEDIUM)
**Checklist Results:**
- [PASS] Landmark regions present (`<form>`)
- [PASS] Heading hierarchy logical (`<h2>`)
- [N/A] Informative images, link text, `lang`, foreign phrases
- [PASS] Form input has visible `<label>` with programmatic association
- [FINDING] Custom widgets use correct ARIA roles matching WAI-ARIA APG patterns (4.1.2)
- [FINDING] Status messages use `aria-live` with appropriate urgency level (4.1.3)
- [N/A] SPA route changes, error association

**Finding:** Autocomplete input and suggestion list lack required ARIA roles (`role="combobox"`, `aria-expanded`, `role="listbox"`, `role="option"`). Screen readers will announce the input as a plain text field and the list as an unstructured group of divs.
**WCAG:** 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value)
**Perspective:** Screen Reader & Semantic Structure
**Severity:** CRITICAL *(Red flag fired: Custom widget with no ARIA role)*
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (secondary: Content Author)
**Evidence:** JSX lines 68–70 (`<input ... />`), lines 75–86 (`<div className="suggestions-list">`)
**Fix:** Add `role="combobox"` and `aria-expanded={showSuggestions}` to input. Wrap list in `<ul role="listbox">`. Add `role="option"` to items. Manage focus or `aria-activedescendant` per APG.

**Finding:** Loading spinner is a visual-only `<div>` with no ARIA live region or `aria-busy` attribute. Screen reader users are not notified that suggestions are loading.
**WCAG:** 4.1.3 (Status Messages)
**Perspective:** Screen Reader & Semantic Structure
**Severity:** MINOR
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (secondary: UX Design)
**Evidence:** JSX line 72 (`<div className="autocomplete-spinner" />`)
**Fix:** Add `role="status"` or `aria-live="polite"` with text "Loading suggestions...", or apply `aria-busy="true"` to the input while `loading` is true.

### Perspective 7: Cognitive & Neurodivergent (HIGH)
**Checklist Results:**
- [PASS] Error messages, multi-step re-asks, auth cognitive tests, navigation consistency, help location, focus auto-trigger, changing value auto-submit, destructive actions, multiple ways to reach
- [FINDING] Input fields for personal data have appropriate `autocomplete` attributes (1.3.5)
- [FINDING] Timeout warnings give ≥ 20 seconds to extend / Timing adjustable (2.2.1)
- [PASS] Content avoids jargon, layout predictable, visual hierarchy clear, no autoplay/unprompted modals

**Finding:** Input field has `autoComplete="off"`, preventing browser autofill for personal address data. This increases cognitive load and motor effort for users relying on autofill/autofocus.
**WCAG:** 1.3.5 (Identify Input Purpose)
**Perspective:** Cognitive & Neurodivergent
**Severity:** MAJOR
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (secondary: UX Design)
**Evidence:** JSX line 70 (`autoComplete="off"`)
**Fix:** Remove `autoComplete="off"` or set to `autoComplete="street-address"` to enable standard browser autofill.

**Finding:** Suggestion dropdown auto-hides after 800ms regardless of user interaction state. This creates a tight, non-adjustable timeout barrier for users who need more time to read or process suggestions.
**WCAG:** 2.2.1 (Timing Adjustable), 3.2.1 (On Focus)
**Perspective:** Cognitive & Neurodivergent
**Severity:** MAJOR
**Route to:** UX Design (secondary: Content Author)
**Evidence:** JS lines 38–43 (`setTimeout(() => setShowSuggestions(false), 800);`)
**Fix:** Remove the auto-hide timeout. Keep the dropdown open until the user selects an item, blurs the input, or presses Escape. If timing is required for UX, provide a visible "Close" button and extend the timeout to at least 20 seconds with a warning prompt.
